title: Macos Zeromq Floor
objective: Build and bind ZeroMQ for the declared macOS 13.5 release floor and fail closed when any embedded Mach-O slice exceeds it

handoff.summary: Integrated the independently reviewed macOS 13.5 ZeroMQ source-build authority, canonical containment checks, exact vcpkg source authentication, immutable native publication, resolved static libzmq/libsodium binding, and runtime dependency receipts. The original lane passed 33 focused tests locally and on the physical Apple-silicon M1 builder; the final provenance follow-up was also witnessed by a successful physical M1 source build.
risks: Source authority is approved, but the final signed and notarized release artifact remains a downstream protected-workflow proof.
next_steps: Run the final macOS arm64 tag candidate through the protected signing environment and retain its receipt, notarization, stapling, and minimum-OS evidence.
